name: lians-memory
description: Deeper understanding, compact memory, and user-owned control inside the agents you already use.
long_description: Lians is a local understanding, memory, control, and verification layer for AI agents. It turns vague requests into bounded working briefs, asks only questions that materially change the work, and supplies relevant current state without replaying an entire history. Observe mode maps content-free activity without changing agent context. Guide mode supplies bounded understanding, current state, tasks, and recovery context. Protect mode adds explicit approval boundaries and reports where a host cannot technically enforce them. Repository verification binds frozen intent and the actual Git diff into a signed receipt, with optional exhaustive proofs over declared finite models. The local 3D Work Graph makes projects, agents, decisions, evidence, blockers, and provenance inspectable without requiring an AI account password, provider API key, hosted prompt proxy, or replacement chat interface.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save one useful fact, preference, decision, or handoff with explicit scope.

tools.name: set_current
tools.description: Atomically update named current state while preserving temporal history.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Recall a small, relevant set of current memories.

tools.name: understand_request
tools.description: Build a local working brief and identify only missing details that materially change the work.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: Inspect saved memories and their current state.

tools.name: memory_health
tools.description: Inspect memory hierarchy, scope, duplication, size, versioning, and staleness without changing content.

tools.name: memory_history
tools.description: Inspect the complete lineage of one named state value.

tools.name: memory_at
tools.description: Resolve what was true, or what an agent knew, at a requested time.

tools.name: track_dependencies
tools.description: Record encrypted relationships between current state and dependent work.

tools.name: state_impact
tools.description: Preview the transitive blast radius of changing one memory.

tools.name: state_repair_brief
tools.description: Return current replacement state plus only the work invalidated by a change.

tools.name: resolve_state_impact
tools.description: Resolve an invalidated dependency after repair evidence or explicit dismissal.

tools.name: start_task
tools.description: Create a durable goal, definition of done, and constraints shared by every agent.

tools.name: checkpoint_task
tools.description: Record task progress, evidence, constraints, blockers, and current action.

tools.name: task_status
tools.description: Verify completion evidence and detect blockers or drift before an agent stops.

tools.name: task_context
tools.description: Return a bounded signed task contract for another agent to continue safely.

tools.name: continue_work
tools.description: Resume the only active task with a bounded signed continuity brief.

tools.name: configure_verification
tools.description: Bind a task to approved repository scope, evidence, checks, formal models, and communication rules.

tools.name: verify_work
tools.description: Inspect Git changes against frozen intent and store a signed verification receipt.

tools.name: verification_status
tools.description: Return the latest signed verification receipt for a task.

tools.name: correct_memory
tools.description: Replace a stale memory while preserving its version history.

tools.name: forget_memory
tools.description: Permanently erase one memory after explicit confirmation.
